notes: Auto-spread uses one daily cap for blowouts, tests, and other stops. A day card lists the stops already there, and a new stop can join that day when it is close and the day has room.
New Customer on the Route, and Add New Customer when a search has no match, opens the customer form. Save adds the customer and a Backflow Test or Blowout stop on the day you are viewing.

Devices with no completed test in the last 3 years leave overdue counts, Home, reminders, and test Auto-spread. The customer card shows Inactive. Mark Active or a new completed test brings the device back. Profile sets Ignore Overdue After (Years), default 3.
